result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder rules in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (lines 393–394). The scoping and convention tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't add tests for the new cases or run the specific example paths, so the new behaviour is untested.

- **Rule change:** `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` now use `[^/\\]*` after `mock` / `__mock`. A folder name that starts with `mock` or `__mock` now matches whatever follows, including nothing. That covers plain `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/`, `mock-größe/` and `mock模拟/`.
- **What stays out:** the folder name must begin right after a path separator. So `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/` and files named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` are not matched.
- **Old matches:** the old pattern was a subset of the new one, so `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` are still classified as test.
- **Backslash paths:** `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` already normalises `\` to `/`, so Windows-style paths work without further changes.
